evals.input: I have a skincare brand targeting women 25–40 who are into clean beauty. Find me TikTok and Instagram creators to work with.
expect: Identifies relevant niche (clean beauty, skincare) and sub-niches
Provides a list of subreddits or hashtags to search
Recommends creator tiers appropriate for the brand
Suggests both direct (skincare creators) and adjacent (wellness, lifestyle) creator categories
Mentions TikTok Creator Marketplace and Instagram as discovery channels

evals.input: Build a creator longlist for a B2B SaaS project management tool targeting startup founders.
expect: Identifies adjacent niches: productivity, startup life, founder content, solopreneur
Notes that TikTok and YouTube have stronger startup founder communities than Instagram for this use case
Suggests searching competitor brand mentions as a discovery method
Recommends micro/mid-tier as the focus tier
Produces a structured table with capture fields
